entities.name: Q9UT55
observations: Reviewed Schizosaccharomyces pombe damage-control phosphatase SPAC806.04c; exact sequence match to the query, 438 aa.
Metal-dependent phosphatase active on fructose-1-phosphate and fructose-6-phosphate; preference for fructose-1-phosphate supports a hexose-phosphate damage-control role.
Mn2+ and Ni2+ are annotated cofactors; localized to cytoplasm and nucleus.
Contains an ARMT1-like domain (PF01937) spanning approximately residues 24-415 and a subfamily III RTxK motif near the C terminus.

entities.name: Fructose-1-phosphate dephosphorylation
observations: beta-D-fructose 1-phosphate + H2O yields D-fructose + phosphate; mapped to Rhea RHEA:35603 and EC 3.1.3.- annotation context.

entities.name: Fructose-6-phosphate cleavage
observations: beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate is converted to dihydroxyacetone and D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate; mapped to Rhea RHEA:28002 in the retrieved annotations.
This activity is reported in the source annotation but should be treated as a secondary substrate/activity claim rather than the primary reaction because the enzyme is classified as a phosphatase.

entities.name: Q9UT55 sequence properties
observations: The query protein is 438 aa, approximately 49.9 kDa, with predicted pI 5.14 and net charge approximately -13 at pH 7.
